name: Bogibeel Bridge
facts: Bogibeel Bridge, opened December 2018, stretches 4.94 km, making it India’s longest rail‑cum‑road bridge and Asia’s second longest, linking Dhemaji and Dibrugarh across the Brahmaputra.
Designed to endure earthquakes up to magnitude 7, Bogibeel Bridge features fully welded steel‑concrete support beams, the first of their kind in India, ensuring 120‑year serviceability.
Construction began in 2002 but stalled until 2011; the project finally cost ₹5,960 crore, a 200‑month effort that expanded the bridge’s length from 4.31 km to 4.94 km.
